visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a gray turtleneck under a plaid dress, dances and poses playfully in front of a large red wall. The wall displays white text including 'Nintendo Switch 2' and 'Taipei'. The scene is brightly lit by overhead convention hall lights. (2) The woman sits in a chair, holding a black handheld gaming console with red and blue controllers attached. She smiles and points at the device, then turns it to show the thin profile of the console to the camera. Background shows other people in red shirts and white chairs. (3) The woman is seen from behind, sitting and playing a racing game on a very large flat-screen TV mounted on a booth. She turns her head back to laugh at someone off-camera. The booth is decorated with Mario Kart themes. (4) Close-up shot focusing strictly on the large TV screen displaying a colorful Mario Kart race. The player finishes the race in first place, and 'FINISH' appears on the screen. (5) A close-up view of the woman's hands holding the handheld console. She uses her thumbs to navigate a character selection menu on the screen, showing various Nintendo characters like Peach and Luigi. (6) The woman walks away from the camera into a large, open event space with high industrial ceilings and many people. She does a little skip as she walks. (7) A wide panning shot across the event venue reveals numerous gaming stations, red ropes for queuing, and staff members wearing red 'Nintendo Switch 2' t-shirts standing ready. (8) Close-up of hands attaching a black strap to a small gaming controller. Then, the woman is shown standing in front of a TV, holding the controller and moving her arms to play a motion-controlled fitness or dance game. (9) The woman is superimposed on a large screen, appearing to be inside a game world with the character Bowser. She dances and moves her arms, while two staff members in red shirts stand nearby. (10) The camera pans through various themed zones of the event hall, showing booths for 'Kirby' and 'Street Fighter 6', with staff and sparse crowds in the background. (11) The woman stands in front of a red wall with the white 'Nintendo' logo, posing with a peace sign and a smile to end the segment.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, approximately 12 staff members in red shirts throughout the venue, and 5-6 other attendees visible in background panning shots.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long, straight black hair, wearing a gray mock-neck long-sleeve shirt under a brown and white plaid overall dress, white socks, and silver flats.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A large, industrial-style convention center (Hua Bo / Expo Park) with high ceilings, exposed metal beams, and large-scale Nintendo-themed branding, booths, and gaming stations.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM featuring bright synth pads and a driving percussion beat. Ambient noise includes a muffled indoor room tone and faint echoes. (2) A female speaker with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone begins talking in Mandarin. The BGM ducks slightly to allow the vocal to remain clear. Background noise of distant chatter and footsteps is present. (3) A brief interaction occurs where a male voice off-camera laughs and speaks; the female creator laughs back. In the background, the recognizable digital beep and engine revving sound effects from a Nintendo game are audible. (4) Loud game SFX trigger as the race finishes: a chime, a digital 'Finish!' voice, and a celebratory melody. The female speaker reacts with a high-energy exclamation of surprise and joy. (5) As the scene shifts, a distinct mechanical 'click' is heard twice, indicating the physical attachment or manipulation of plastic controllers. The BGM remains constant throughout this sequence. (6) Another female voice (staff member) is heard briefly giving a short instruction. This is followed by game-related sound effects including countdown pips ('be-be-be-boop') and stylized cartoon impact noises. (7) The video concludes with the BGM sustaining its energetic pace, layered with the main speaker's final enthusiastic sign-off and the faint hum of the large venue's acoustics.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Experience 1 -> Experience 2 -> Experience 3 -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and showcase the features of the new 'Nintendo Switch 2' by documenting a hands-on experience at an official media preview event. The creator highlights the device's physical design, portability, and several game titles to build excitement and provide informative commentary.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses entirely on a specific new product (Nintendo Switch 2), the creator is wearing a 'Media' pass, and the content is framed as a positive first-look review at an official brand event.
